ns2:course.label: Seminar History of Philosophy
ns2:course.description: Study of selected major philosophers, movements, problems, or topics in the history of philosophy. Approved for letter grading when offered for 4 hours of credit; approved for S/U grading when offered for 2 hours of credit - only available for Stage 3 Philosophy PhD students. May be repeated in the same or separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
